item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a 2024 source showing Srettha directly ordering security forces to stop torture, release political detainees, or resolve enforced-disappearance cases. The record is mostly formal commitments plus reactions to specific abuses, while the strongest negative evidence shows continuing arbitrary detention and unresolved impunity rather than a clearly new, Srettha-directed campaign of state violence.","evidence":[{"title":"Thailand deposits Instrument of Ratification to the International Convention for the Protection of all Persons from Enforced Disappearance (ICPPED)","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-05-16","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/icpped140524-2?page=5d5bd3da15e39c306002aaf9","summary":"Thailand ratified the disappearance treaty and said its anti-torture/anti-disappearance law would be an important tool; this is direct institutional evidence of stronger safeguards against enforced disappearance and torture.","question_ids":["3B.1"]},{"title":"Prime Minister delivers statement at 3rd Summit for Democracy, highlighting Thailand’s commitment to democracy, rule of law, and human rights at home and abroad","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"2024-03-20","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/summit-for-democracy-3-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Srettha publicly committed to democracy, rule of law, and human rights at home and abroad; this supports a protective intent, though it does not by itself prove enforcement.","question_ids":["3B.1"]},{"title":"Thai Prime Minister Promises Investigation After Activist Died in Detention","publisher":"Khaosod English / Associated Press","date":"2024-05-15","url":"https://www.khaosodenglish.com/politics/2024/05/15/thai-prime-minister-promises-investigation-after-activist-died-in-detention/","summary":"After Netiporn Sanesangkhom died in custody, Srettha promised an investigation. That is limited accountability response evidence, not a full record of reform.","question_ids":["3B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand: Tragic death of detained activist must be ‘wake-up call’","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-05-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/05/thailand-tragic-death-of-detained-activist-must-be-wake-up-call/","summary":"Amnesty said Netiporn had been held in arbitrary detention for peaceful protest, and her death in custody created a presumption of state responsibility absent a prompt, effective investigation.","question_ids":["3B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand: Investigate Detained Youth Activist’s Death","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/23/thailand-investigate-detained-youth-activists-death","summary":"HRW said hundreds of critics of the monarchy were in pretrial detention, urged an end to arbitrary detention and prosecutions, and called for a prompt, transparent investigation into the custodial death.","question_ids":["3B.1"]},{"title":"Thailand: Last-Ditch Effort for Tak Bai Massacre Justice","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-05-01","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/01/thailand-last-ditch-effort-tak-bai-massacre-justice","summary":"HRW said successive Thai governments had failed to prosecute those responsible for the Tak Bai crackdown deaths and injuries; continued impunity undercut Srettha’s rule-of-law pledge.","question_ids":["3B.1"]}]}
